title: compact-session-tokens-heartbeat-ws-throttle-and-interop-shim
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: This PR introduces a lightweight cross-SDK session token wrapper, a heartbeat/keepalive handshake for long-lived sessions, and a WebSocket throttle shim to provide stable backpressure on browsers and embedded platforms. The change targets Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs to reduce duplication and surface a single, ergonomic API for session lifecycles and streaming backpressure. Summary: - Add CompactSessionToken (language idiomatic wrappers) that centralizes token expiry, refresh scheduling, and a small lease API. - Introduce optional heartbeatKeepalive() helper on streaming clients to emit periodic pings and surface liveness to both client and server. - Add wsThrottle adapter for browsers and constrained runtimes to limit in-flight chunk buffering and surface an async backpressure signal to stream consumers. - Normalize retry presets for auth-related errors across SDKs and add a new "session-fallthrough" retry profile. - Bump versions: python-sdk v2.11.0, typescript-sdk v1.8.2, go-sdk v1.5.4. Backwards compatibility: All helpers are opt-in. Existing public APIs continue to behave the same unless users adopt CompactSessionToken or enabled heartbeat/thsrottle adapters. Migration notes: For customers using long-lived streams in browser contexts we recommend enabling wsThrottle with default params; server-side deployments should prefer heartbeatKeepalive paired with server-side lease renewal to reduce unnecessary reconnects. Checklist: - [x] Implement CompactSessionToken across three SDKs - [x] Add heartbeatKeepalive helper and tests - [x] Add wsThrottle adapter with examples - [x] Unify retry profile name and docs - [x] Add interop e2e tests across language bindings - [x] Update changelogs and bump package versions Tests & CI: Added unit tests for token expiry scheduling, simulated heartbeat races, integration test that spins up local echo server and verifies throttle behavior under bursty input. CI matrix: python/ts/go unit tests and integration e2e on linux-amd64. Observability: Instrumented new metrics: sdk.session.leases.heartbeat.sent, sdk.session.leases.refresh.attempt, sdk.stream.ws.throttle.wait_ms. The metrics are lightweight and only emitted when helpers are enabled. Security: Token wrapper respects KMS-backed token sources. No secrets shipped in SDK. Release strategy: Release as minor bumps across SDKs with comprehensive "migration" section in release notes. Merge method: squash and merge. Related tickets: ENG-1349, ENG-1412. Related linear tasks: ENG-1349, ENG-1412. Notes for reviewers: Focus on cross-language parity, ensure retry window aligns with server-side lease policy, and look for race conditions in heartbeat vs. token-refresh.

release_notes: Introduce CompactSessionToken: opt-in lightweight session lease API that centralizes token expiry and refresh scheduling. Add heartbeatKeepalive helper for long-lived streams to reduce reconnects and improve stability. Add wsThrottle adapter to provide backpressure-friendly streaming on browser/embedded runtimes. Unified session-fallthrough retry profile across SDKs. Version bumps: python v2.11.0, typescript v1.8.2, go v1.5.4.
